proposal.description: Blink timebase is held in reset while no strikes are outstanding, so it is started by the first strike instead of running freely
proposal.reason: When strike_level goes non-zero partway through a blink period, Red_LED1's first toggle now comes a full half-period after the strike rather than at the free-running phase, so the blink edges on Red_LED1 move in time.

proposal.description: Blink counter is not reloaded at the half-period terminal count and wraps at 2^BLINK_W, so only the first half-period is the right length
proposal.reason: While strikes are outstanding, Red_LED1 toggles after the right half-period the first time, then every 2^BLINK_W clocks, so the blink period it shows is wrong.

proposal.description: Loss of power-good is treated as a live fault, which puts out the running indicator
proposal.reason: During soft-start, before the rail reaches regulation (ss_active high, pgood low), Green_LED stays dark even though the converter is switching with no fault.

proposal.description: Green LED is turned off while strikes are outstanding, against the rule that Green and Red_LED1 are both lit during the clean-run window
proposal.reason: After a hiccup recovery, while the board runs with strike_level non-zero, Green_LED stays dark instead of lit next to the blinking Red_LED1.

proposal.description: Strike blink outranks the latched-trip solid indication
proposal.reason: After the strike counter trips the latch, strike_level stays non-zero, so Red_LED1 blinks instead of staying solid in the latched state.

proposal.description: Outstanding strikes are detected from the LSB of strike_level alone, so a level of 2 counts as no strikes
proposal.reason: With two strikes outstanding and no latch (strike_level == 2), Red_LED1 stays off instead of blinking.

why: make lint already catches it: make lint: UNUSEDSIGNAL

proposal.description: Strike blink is shown only while the converter is not switching, not for the whole time strikes are outstanding
proposal.reason: After a hiccup, once the retry enters soft-start or run with strike_level still non-zero, Red_LED1 goes dark instead of blinking until the clean-run window clears the strikes.

proposal.description: Red_LED1 holds its last value when neither a latch nor strikes are present, instead of being cleared
proposal.reason: If the clean-run window clears strike_level during the lit half of the blink, Red_LED1 stays on for good instead of going off.

proposal.description: Over-temperature indicator is made sticky until reset, like a fault_cause history bit, instead of showing the live condition
proposal.reason: After otp_state rises and then falls when the board cools, Red_LED2 stays lit instead of following the comparator back low.

proposal.description: Undervoltage indicator is chained after over-temperature and suppressed while OTP is live, instead of being independent
proposal.reason: When uvlo_state and otp_state are both high, Red_LED3 is dark although input undervoltage is present.

proposal.description: Power-good LED is gated by run_active, so it ignores the comparator in every state except S_RUN
proposal.reason: When pgood rises during soft-start (ss_active high, run_active low), pgood_LED stays dark until the supervisor enters run, instead of following the comparator.
